name: Owlbeast Talon procs on damaging spells and abilities (#13440)
contract: #13440: Owlbeast Talon (proc dummies 202152, 312761, 316761, 320761) never procced. Every dummy carries
Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it. Tooltip:
"Damaging spells and abilities", tiers "(10sec. internal cooldown)". Flags 69904 (melee, ranged, magic and
none damage class harmful spells, no auto attacks) as the merged Stormrage 6-piece row for "a harmful
ability". spell_proc_chance reads each loaded entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and
spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision,
including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic event per check. It procs on a landed melee ability (Heroic
Strike 78), a landed ranged ability (Arcane Shot 3044), a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116), at the
record's chance; it never procs on a landed melee auto attack, a landed ranged auto attack, a periodic
Shadow tick (Shadow Word: Pain 589). Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups fail with 'Spell has
no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of flaking.
